title: Parables of the Kingdom Bible Crossword Puzzle — Free on iOS
heading: The Parables of the Kingdom Bible Crossword
description: Solve a parables Bible crossword: the treasure in the field, the pearl of great price, the mustard seed and the leaven. KJV clues from Matthew 13, free on iOS.
prose: Matthew 13 is a chapter of short, strange comparisons, one after another: the kingdom is like treasure hid in a field, like a merchant man seeking goodly pearls, like a grain of mustard seed, like leaven a woman hid in three measures of meal. Parables of the Kingdom makes a grid of them all.
Each clue points at one parable's distinguishing object, so solving the puzzle sorts the chapter into its parts. The closing verse is the treasure in the field, and the joy of the man who found it.

clues.text: The least of all seeds, grown into a tree
Hid in three measures of meal
Goodly ones sought by the merchant man

verseText: Again, the kingdom of heaven is like unto treasure hid in a field; the which when a man hath found, he hideth, and for joy thereof goeth and selleth all that he hath, and buyeth that field.
